scope: Document organization and conditional deadline references only; no tax liability, filing decision or submission.
name: United Kingdom

deadlines.label: Standard paper Self Assessment return deadline
deadlines.appliesWhen: 2025–26 paper return where the standard deadline applies; a later notice may set a different date.

deadlines.label: Standard online Self Assessment return deadline
deadlines.appliesWhen: 2025–26 online return where the standard deadline applies; confirm any different HMRC notice.

documents.income: Collect interest, dividend and employment-income statements.
documents.disposals: Collect purchase/disposal statements and costs for review.
documents.foreign-accounts: Collect foreign income, account and withholding evidence.
documents.wrappers: Collect ISA and pension account records; ask which information is relevant.
documents.retirement: Collect pension income and contribution records.

questions: Confirm the 6 April–5 April period rather than assuming a calendar year.
Ask whether residence, foreign-income rules or a notice to file changes applicability.
Do not infer that Self Assessment is required from an account balance.
